exposure: Severity of COVID-19 (mild vs moderate-severe) in pregnant women receiving convalescent plasma therapy
outcome: Clinical characteristics (e.g., systemic corticosteroids, oxygen support, ICU admission, length of hospitalization)
Laboratory parameters (e.g., O2 saturation levels, platelet, plateletcrit, and lymphocyte counts)
cohort: The cohort consists of 36 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19, categorized by disease severity (12 mild and 24 moderate-severe), who received convalescent plasma therapy.
finding: Early convalescent plasma treatment may be associated with improvements in laboratory and ventilatory parameters in pregnant women with both mild and moderate-severe COVID-19.
